name: Grade 8 IT: Vector Graphics and Design
description: Vector graphics, bitmap images, fill, stroke, z-order, alignment, grouping, paths, nodes, SVG markup, and campaign logo improvement.

words.definition: A graphic made from paths and shapes that can scale clearly.
words.example: A logo is often a vector graphic.
A photo is usually a bitmap image.

words.definition: The inside color of a vector shape.
words.example: The circle had a green fill.

words.definition: The outline of a vector shape or path.
words.example: The icon used a dark stroke.

words.definition: A level in a design that controls object order.
words.example: The background layer stayed behind the logo.

words.definition: The front-to-back order of objects in a design.
words.example: Changing z-order moved the leaf in front.
The icons were aligned along the same edge.
The shapes were distributed across the badge.

words.definition: To combine objects so they move together.
A line or curve used to create a vector object.
words.example: The leaf was made from a curved path.

words.definition: A point on a path that can be edited.
words.example: Moving the node changed the curve.

words.definition: A vector tool used to draw straight or curved paths.
words.example: The pen tool made the water drop shape.

words.definition: A markup format for vector graphics.
words.example: The SVG code changed the icon color.

words.definition: Text code that describes structure or appearance.
words.example: Markup described what the vector image looked like.

words.definition: Able to change size while staying clear.
words.example: A scalable logo works on a poster and website.

words.definition: A planned message that tries to inform or persuade.
words.example: The campaign icon promoted clean energy.

words.definition: Helpful comments about strengths and improvements.
To save a file in a format for sharing or submitting.
words.example: The student exported the badge as an image.
